items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Prior supervisory experience with demonstrated success in employee performance management, coaching, and accountability.
Knowledge and/or experience working in an academic institution – preferred.

As the Administrative Supervisor, you will lead a team dedicated to providing administrative support to the Faculty in the Department of Pathology & Laboratory Medicine. Your team will manage various administrative services, including calendar management, travel arrangements, reimbursements, and conference coordination.  Key responsibilities include:
Supervise the daily operations of the Pathology Administrative Services, ensuring seamless workflow and optimal performance.
Provide guidance and support to a team of administrative professionals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional development.
Managing all aspects of supervision, including hiring, performance management, discipline, and complaint resolution.
Implementing best practices and protocols to enhance operational efficiency.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, database management and timekeeping software.

Proven ability to identify and address performance concerns, provide constructive feedback, establish clear expectations, and implement performance improvement plans or corrective actions as appropriate.
Ability to navigate difficult conversations, resolve employee relations issues, and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Advanced organizational and project management skills.
Strong analytical skills for troubleshooting and problem-solving.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees and leadership.
